title: 법원 감사위원회 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
full_text:
Article 3 (Composition of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall consist of seven members, including one chairperson and one vice-chairperson.
(2) Six members, including the chairperson and vice-chairperson, shall be commissioned by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court from among persons outside the judiciary who enjoy high public esteem and have extensive experience in the legal profession, academia, the news media, business, women's organizations, or civic organizations.
(3) The remaining one member shall be appointed by the Chief Justice of the Supreme Court from among judges.
